crossRefs.note: “Separate yourselves from among this congregation, that I may consume them in a moment!”

people.name: Abiram
people.line: Reubenite who rebelled against Moses and Aaron

people.name: Dathan
people.line: Reubenite who rebelled against Moses and Aaron

people.name: Korah
people.line: Levite rebel leader; his descendants became temple servants

translations.web: “Speak to the congregation, saying, ‘Get away from around the tent of Korah, Dathan, and Abiram!’ ”
translations.bsb: “Tell the congregation to move away from the dwellings of Korah, Dathan, and Abiram.”
translations.kjv: Speak unto the congregation, saying, Get you up from about the tabernacle of Korah, Dathan, and Abiram.
translations.asv: Speak unto the congregation, saying, Get you up from about the tabernacle of Korah, Dathan, and Abiram.
